output.reason: New bladder control trouble and numbness between the legs a week after a lifting back injury are cardinal features of cauda equina syndrome, a surgical emergency requiring immediate emergency assessment with MRI capability.
output.patientMessage: Go to the emergency department now. New trouble controlling your bladder plus numbness between your legs after a back injury can mean nerve compression at the base of the spine, which needs urgent scanning and possible surgery today. Do not wait for a reply. If you cannot get there quickly, or you develop leg weakness or cannot pass urine, call 911.
